$comment: Every tunable lives here: type, range, default, menu section. The in-VR menu and config validation both read this file.

features.camera_override.label: Stage 1: head pose owns the camera (Numpad0 toggles)

features.xr.label: Use the headset (off = desktop simulator only). Needs a restart

stereo.mode.label: 3D: alternate = one eye per frame (true 3D); mono = same picture both eyes

stereo.sync.label: 3D eye sync: hold the world still while the second eye is drawn (Shift+F4)

input.left_handed.label: Left-handed: move with the right stick (mirrors all controls)

input.stick_pitch.label: Right stick up/down also looks up/down (off: head and mouse only)

rendering.taa_per_eye.label: Anti-aliasing history kept per eye (sharper, less shimmer in 3D)

camera.pitch_source.label: Look up/down from: auto (headset if present), game (mouse/stick), head

diagnostics.typeinfo_dump.label: Recon: dump engine type list once (developer)

diagnostics.stereo_experiment.label: Stage 2 experiment: two views per frame via split-screen (developer)

diagnostics.fov_test.label: Apply the full-FOV override without a headset, with a stand-in 90 deg FOV (developer)

diagnostics.cb_capture.label: Recon: F10 captures one frame of shader constants (developer)

diagnostics.time_recon.label: Recon: record which code reads the clock, once, at the menu (developer)

diagnostics.zero_ipd.label: Both eyes drawn from the head centre - for checking that the eyes of a pair match (developer)

diagnostics.ipd_scale.label: Eye separation x this (developer checks; 1 = real)

diagnostics.ipd_vertical.label: Eyes stacked vertically instead of side by side (developer checks)

diagnostics.taa_motion_fix.label: Per-eye TAA: correct motion vectors to this eye's previous camera (developer A/B)

diagnostics.motion_fix_debug.label: Per-eye TAA: run the motion fix but write zeros (developer)

diagnostics.motion_fix_jitter.label: Per-eye TAA: jitter term in the motion fix (developer)

diagnostics.sync_hold_dt.label: Eye sync: dt reported on held frames (developer)

comfort.game_camera_motion.label: Feel the game's camera motion: rolls, wall-run tilt, landing dips (F5). Intense

comfort.height_offset.label: Extra eye height (F3 up / F2 down)

rendering.full_fov.label: Fill the headset's whole field of view (off = the game's own FOV in a window)
